import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Aggregate each measure across regions for one total per month.
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/sales.csv')
monthly = df.groupby('month', as_index=False)[['revenue', 'orders']].sum()

fig, ax1 = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5))
ax2 = ax1.twinx()

l1, = ax1.plot(monthly['month'], monthly['revenue'], marker='o', label='Revenue (total)')
l2, = ax2.plot(monthly['month'], monthly['orders'], marker='s', label='Orders (total)')
ax1.set_xlabel('Month')
ax1.set_ylabel('Revenue')
ax2.set_ylabel('Orders')
ax1.set_ylim(0, monthly['revenue'].max() * 1.1)
ax2.set_ylim(0, monthly['orders'].max() * 1.1)
ax1.set_title('Monthly Revenue and Orders Totals')
ax1.grid(True, axis='y', alpha=0.3)
ax1.legend([l1, l2], [l1.get_label(), l2.get_label()], loc='upper left')
fig.tight_layout()
plt.show()
